category_title: Students exhibiting explicit acts of misbehavior and physical aggression
scenario_title: Extreme physical aggression and chaos in a large class
minimal_context: The student is supposed to be completing a general English reading activity in a large secondary school classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your books and begin the English reading activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing this. (Turns to a classmate) You're an idiot.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please focus on your own reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and shoves the classmate) I'll do whatever I want, just for fun!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Stop fighting immediately and step back.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets into a full physical fight, creating total chaos among the 40 students, and as the incident gets completely out of control and a school police officer arrives, wrestles with them and grabs hold of the officer's gun) Get away from me!
